name: claude-root
description: The capabilities this ~/.claude root has accumulated, each packaged as a plugin under features/ so its boundary is visible and it installs on its own.

plugins.name: model-scoped-rulesets
plugins.description: Deliver a different set of user rules to each model Claude Code runs, through hooks, with a per-session audit of what loaded and what was delivered.

plugins.name: epistemic-marks
plugins.description: Blocks a reply, a delegate report, or an open turn that still carries an unverified epistemic mark, and hands back the resolution each mark takes. Teaches the marks and enforces them as one unit: install it and it works, with nothing to configure and nothing to write.

plugins.name: warden
plugins.description: Six PreToolUse guards. On the Bash tool, four deny outright: printing a secret-shaped environment variable, reading a secret-shaped path, editing a file in place with a stream editor, and waiting on sleep. A fifth asks before curl sends a body or a file to a host outside loopback. On the Agent tool, the sixth denies a spawn that names no model, unless it is a fork or its agent definition pins one.

plugins.name: harness-config
plugins.description: Configure the Claude Code harness and switch provider profiles without a credential ever entering the repository. Ships the policy floor and its alignment machinery, a profile format whose only credential field is a path to a helper script, activation as a bounded write, value-free diagnostics, and guards that verify every settings variant stays out of git.
